name: top.clarkding.oom.jvm.monitor.analysis.HeapAnalysisService
description: ClarkMonitor's JVM memory analyzer starts when the library submits a saved memory snapshot. It checks the snapshot for leaked screens and retained objects, then writes a report in a separate process.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops ClarkMonitor from producing JVM leak reports; ordinary app screens do not depend on this separate analysis service.
